---
title: "fastNMF MP workflow"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
source("R/fastnmf.R")
set.seed(1)
X <- abs(matrix(rnorm(8000), nrow = 200, ncol = 40))
rownames(X) <- paste0("G", seq_len(nrow(X)))
out <- run_nmf_ranks(X, ranks = 4:6, top_genes = 150, topN = 50, nrun = 1, max_iter = 30)
dim(out$Genes_nmf_w_basis)
head(colnames(out$Genes_nmf_w_basis))
```
